pkg.summary: Where the day ends, light meets the dark.
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(Female ethereal humming layer, deep reverb, wide stereo, ambient pad forming vast space, soft orchestral swell, immediate atmosphere within first 5-10 seconds)
Liaenae... soa rimae... (floating airy high vocal, long reverb tail)

[Verse 1]
(Female Vocal - airy high, ethereal, vowel-flowing light language)
Sia nae liae ru
Aeora miya soa
Rimae nae elia

(Male Vocal - deep whisper, consonant-heavy, grounded dark language, alternating)
Krath vor nek
Dak tor vae

[Pre-Chorus]
(Female Vocal, building ethereal lead + soft choir layer)
Ha-ru nae soa liae
Lia nae ru siaa
(soft strings swell, minimal beat pulse, increasing reverb)

[Build Up]
(Both vocals alternating, rising tension, orchestral strings + sub bass depth)
Liaenae soa rimae
Krath voren dak

[Energy Rise]
(Female airy vocal leading, male entering subtly, choir rising)
Aeora miya soa
Zek tor varun

[Drop]
(0.5s silence before impact - light first, then dark collision)
(Female Vocal - high airy expansion + choir)
Liaenae soa rimae!
Eliara noae siya!

(Male Vocal - 0.2-0.5s delay, heavy grounded impact)
Krath vor nek tor!
Vak nae dron!

(Orchestral strings swell, choir layer explosion, sub bass depth, cinematic hits, wide stereo energy wave collision, deep reverb filling the space)

[After Drop]
(Female humming layer rising, residual reverb tails, ethereal pad)
Lia... nae... soa... (floating background)

[Chorus]
(Female leading with choir, male alternating then brief collision)
Ha-ru nae soa liae
Lia nae ru siaa
Krath vor nek tor
Vak nae dron

(All moments embrace me - every instant fills the quiet evening)
(Male + Female layered choir, strings, sub bass, epic expansion)

[Interlude]
(Ambient pad + long reverb tails, soft humming only, space breathing)

[Verse 2]
(Male low chant/rap style, dark language, grounded rhythm)
Kra-ru nek tor vae
Dak thoren vak
(Female soft response, alternating)

[Low Chant / Rap]
(Male deep whisper chant)
Zek tor varun krath
Voren dak nae

[Transition Build]
(Both building, strings + choir density increase, energy rise)
Liaenae soa rimae
Krath voren dak

[Climax Rise]
(Full orchestral swell, choir layering thicker)
Aeora miya soa
Eliara noae siya

[Drop 2]
(Stronger collision, added choir density, bigger scale)
(Female high airy + massive choir)
Liaenae soa rimae!
Eliara noae siya!

(Male heavy impact)
Krath vor nek tor!
Vak nae dron!

(Full cinematic hits, low brass, sub bass, epic light vs dark wave explosion)

[Aftermath]
(Residual humming + reverb, strings fading into ambient)

[Final Chorus]
(Repeated with maximum choir density, both vocals colliding more)
Ha-ru nae soa liae
Lia nae ru siaa
Krath vor nek tor
Vak nae dron
(Everything embraces me, quiet evening fills me - grand majestic close)

[Extended Ambient]
(Extended reverb tails, soft humming layer only, slow fade layers)

[Outro]
(Ambient pad + final long reverb tails fading out slowly, no abrupt end, soft ethereal humming lingering)
Liaenae... soa... rimae... (disappearing into vast space)

Sound: deep reverb, long delay, wide stereo, no drums, no percussion, no beat, low end far, diffused, arrhythmic, mid-low filled by strings, choir, brass, slow evolving layers, stable tempo.
